title: Raku - Fast Fire Techniques
summary: Six-week intermediate raku class firing pottery to 1,800°F with post-fire reduction in sawdust or grass, exploring copper reds, greens, blues, and horsehair/feather techniques. All supplies provided; bring optional bisque ware.
source_quote: Session 1: Sep 24 - Oct 29th , 2026... Raku - Fast Fire Techniques... Experience the excitement and unpredictability of raku firing in this intermediate-level course. We'll glaze and fire pottery to around 1,800°F before pulling the glowing pieces from the kiln and placing them into sawdust or dry grass to create unique copper reds, greens, blues, and smoky effects
evidence_sentence: The course page describes firing pottery in a raku kiln to 1,800°F with post-fire reduction in sawdust or grass, with copper red, green, and blue effects.
evidence_quote: We'll glaze and fire pottery to around 1,800°F before pulling the glowing pieces from the kiln and placing them into sawdust or dry grass to create unique copper reds, greens, blues, and smoky effects
